title: Mozart typography tool

location.series: COLLINS / San Francisco Symphony case study
location.extent: Whole published artwork or representative frame of complete local clip

slide_intent: Expose reusable controls because a flexible identity needs a practical method for producing coherent variants.
strategic_value: A visible typography tool can make the Symphony’s changing letterforms repeatable by its designers.
demonstration: A tool demonstration cycles Mozart through ten size and slant arrangements on a black canvas beside a control panel.
practical_value: Compare preset shapes and letter arrangements while keeping the same word as a test case.

content_islands.spec: Keep Mozart large on the black canvas at left through all ten states.

content_islands.name: Control panel
content_islands.spec: Preserve the right-side shape presets and sliders without inventing unreadable parameter values.
